content.premise: Two friends are locked in the Hush Garden at closing time, at the tower in the middle of its maze. Something old sleeps under the lanes, and it wakes to footsteps. One runs for the far gate; the other climbs the tower and calls the way.
content.theme: A walled hedge maze over something that sleeps and listens: one friend runs the lanes while the other calls the way from the tower.
content.title: The Hush Garden
